messages:
Aisha: Hey team — EUBank procurement just told legal they need ISO-27001 Annex A excerpts + a signed pen-test attestation before executing the SOW. POC kicks off Mon. Can we assemble artifacts and confirm any pricing impact if they request dedicated/burst capacity for the run?
Noah: We can provision a staging tenant and IP allowlist. For burst capacity during a short POC we can do a temporary Dedicated pool, but that usually moves to reserved pricing depending on duration. Need dates and how many concurrent workers. cc @Ben for numbers.
Ben: Short answer on pricing: if burst is <=7 days we can offer a temporary add-on billed at ~1.3x hosted rate (one-time). Anything >7 days we need to quote Dedicated monthly commit. I can draft an addendum if Aisha confirms dates.
Lena: Artifacts we can provide quickly: SOC 2 Type II summary report (redacted), ISO-27001 Statements of Applicability excerpts, architecture/network diagram, KMS/key flow, change control and release evidence. Pen-test attestation: we have a standard template that security can sign off on but legal needs to approve the language.
compliance-bot: SOC2+ISO excerpt bundle ready: presigned URL https://s3.redwood-example/presigned/eubank_bundle.zip (expires in 48h). If you need raw logs or vuln scan output, request specifically.
Aisha: EUBank CISO asked the pen-test letter to explicitly state 'no findings affecting data exfiltration'. Can we confirm acceptable language? Also they asked if an on-prem/private deployment is an option for the POC data residency requirement.
Lena: We can’t make absolute statements. Proposed wording: 'A penetration test conducted on [date] by [vendor] did not identify any critical findings affecting data confidentiality or exfiltration for the tested scope.' We'll run this by legal and the test vendor for accuracy. On-prem/private: feasible but will add ~2–3 weeks to timeline and requires a Private deployment review + infra sign-off.
Noah: For the POC artifacts handoff, recommend an ephemeral service account + SFTP or presigned S3. Example command for their ops to upload artifacts to our intake bucket:
```aws s3 cp evidence.zip s3://redwood-poc-uploads/eubank/ --acl private```
Ben: Aisha — confirm POC window and which days they want the burst runs. I’ll prepare a one-off quote/addendum and temporary invoice if needed.
Aisha: Confirmed POC window: 2026-04-06 to 2026-04-13. They want burst on Tue + Thu for load runs. I’ll get the CISO contact and legal rep on the thread after the 11am call. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
